performanceContract: Do not ship full ChatSnapshotBuilder legacy compatibility projection in a permanent parallel helper pipeline.

Minimal implementation should keep per-turn/per-step metadata indexes referencing already-retained events/blocks and original hasReply/noToolCall/finalNode semantics. Reuse original ClientAssistantStream settlement fold where feasible; actual original assembler remains QA oracle.

A metadata-only original-assembler view is a valid tested fallback prototype, not yet a production recommendation: it avoids legacy finalized scans but still materializes5150 nodes across100 growing-step transitions and has substantial baseline index memory.
No per-chunk value()/full message history serialization; maintain dirty publication and suffix deltas. Metadata patches only when qualification/placement flags change.
